title: Titanium Blind Flange (ASME B16.5)
function: Class 150/300 blind flange for chemical piping
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for this pipe fitting application prioritizing formability and corrosion resistance over strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, its natural TiO2 passivation provides immunity to pitting in chlorides up to 260C. This rationale is driven by class 150/300 blind flange for chemical piping and fat life requirements.
process: Hot forming plate rolling for pipe fitting geometry
CNC corrosion allowance at 200W fiber laser
TIG welding Grade 2 at 200W fiber laser
Hydrostatic shell test at 200W fiber laser
surfaceTreatment: Pickling + passivation per ASTM B600 to restore TiO2 passive layer integrity after welding or hot forming — tailored for class 150300 blind application
commonFailures: Pitting in stagnant HCl above 60C - requires Grade 12 for Mo-enhanced passive film stability — critical for class 150300 blind performance

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Blind Flange (ASME B16.5) suitable for Class 150/300 blind flange for chemical piping?
faq.a: Titanium Blind Flange (ASME B16.5) uses Grade 2 CP-Ti because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address pipe fitting operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Blind Flange (ASME B16.5)?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Blind Flange (ASME B16.5) is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for class 150300 blind requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Blind Flange (ASME B16.5) require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. class 150300 blind components require Pickling + passivation per ASTM B600 to restore TiO2 passive layer integrity after welding or hot forming — tailored for class 150300 blind application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Blind Flange (ASME B16.5) shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Blind Flange (ASME B16.5) includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet class 150300 blind specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for Blind flange / ASME flange pipe fitting components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
